title: Known validate failures
description: A caller-reviewed list of `govkit validate` failures accepted as already existing. A valid record is well-formed; it does not show that anyone reviewed it, and GovKit never writes or accepts one. Entries are matched by scope, check identifier and finding code, never by message text.

name.description: The feature directory name, the extension id, or the fix record path relative to the repository root. Omitted for the approval scope.

check.description: A check identifier printed by a scoped `govkit validate` run. An identifier GovKit does not know for the scope kind makes the record invalid.

finding.description: The finding code within the check, when the check reports one. An entry without a finding matches only a failure that has none.

note.description: Why the failure is accepted. Not read by GovKit.
